payload.body_they: {{Name}} can be very good at keeping home and family responsibilities functioning, but a well-managed home is not automatically somewhere they get to rest. They may become the person who tracks the repairs, appointments, logistics, and responsibilities nobody else remembers. Some of those responsibilities are theirs because they chose them. Others remain theirs because everyone got used to them handling them. They can honor their roots without letting home become another job.
